Neighbourhood Pride Short Form

Below are several descriptions of how you may feel. Please use the scale below to rate the degree to which each statement applies to you.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. My neighbourhood is better than the others nearby.

_____2. I respect the habits of other neighbourhoods.

_____3. Other neighbourhoods should copy ours.

_____4. I don't respect the ways of other neighbourhoods.

_____5. I enjoy visiting other neighbourhoods.

_____6. I would rather never visit other neighbourhoods.

Scoring:  To compute your scores, add your scores for each item as indicated below:
Recode questions 2, 5 with the following format:
1	=	5
2	=	4
3	=	3
4	=	2
5	=	1

After you have recoded the previous questions, add all of the numbers together to get your composite neighbourhood pride score.
